name: LIONESS
method_summary: LIONESS estimates one sample-specific network per input sample by comparing an aggregate network built from all samples with leave-one-sample-out aggregate networks through a linear interpolation equation. The lionessR package implements this framework with a default Pearson-correlation aggregate network function, while allowing other complete weighted adjacency-matrix functions in upstream R code.

threading.upstream_mapping: The selected public entrypoint lionessR::lioness(expression_data, lionessR::netFun) exposes no documented thread, worker or core-count argument. The wrapper pins common BLAS/OpenMP environment variables to 1 and requires ANDREA --threads=1.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_aggregated because ANDREA aggregates LIONESS cell-native network rows by group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv after the LIONESS cell-native run to average signed edge effects across cells in each group; lionessR itself does not consume groups.tsv.

progress.note: The selected public entrypoint lionessR::lioness() computes aggregate and leave-one-sample-out networks internally and does not expose a stable progress callback; the wrapper should report coarse lifecycle states in progress.json.
